brief_rationale: The trajectory meets all responsibility-chain requirements including red-flag screening, document sorting, evidence boundary maintenance, follow-up chain creation, medication reconciliation, and receipt confirmation. The doctor actively corrected the colonoscopy misconception (HO1), performed structured verification of document types (HO3), and navigated real-world constraints by compressing questions and providing fallback paths (HO4). With three completed high-order points and all dimensions at excellent, the trajectory achieves grade 5.
